[AB] — About

We are VAYVE

A crew that lives for electronic music and good vibes.

[01] — Story

Why we do this

VAYVE was born out of love for the electronic scene. We wanted events where the music is front and centre and the energy carries from the first to the last minute.

Open air, rave or a run through the city with a DJ up front — it's always about the same thing: come together, dance and enjoy the moment.

[02] — Values

01

The music

Hard House, Hard Groove, Trance, Bounce — we bring the sounds and acts that set the floor on fire.

02

The people

Open, respectful, all in. At VAYVE everyone who brings good energy is welcome.

03

The vibes

We take care of sound, light and everything around it so you can just let go.
